findings.claim: 2026-06 報導 onsemi 捷克 SiC 廠擬裁最多 300 人，起因為中國低價 SiC 競爭；TrendForce 稱中國 SICC、天科合達占 2025 N 型基板銷售約 21.5%、20.1%

findings.excerpt: China Exposure: onsemi derives approximately 30% of its revenue from China. While it has design wins in 60% of Chinese EV models, geopolitical tensions and potential trade tariffs remain a primary risk.

findings.claim: 捷克 Rožnov 廠 2026-06 擬裁 200–300 人，與中國 SiC 低價競爭有關；捷克新廠補貼約 €450M
findings.excerpt: at Czech facility Dennis Dahlgren US semiconductor manufacturer Onsemi is reportedly planning to cut between 200 and 300 jobs at its plant in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm in the Czech Republic, according to Czech media outlet e15.
